items:
A work permit must 
 be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable 
 safety category,
Safety fence with cautions marks surrounding the work area is required
Wear your safety helmet & shoes .... etc
Switch off the control circuit (DC voltage)

sections.text:
Inspect the insulators, if porcelain shows shops and scratches. 
replace them by new one using a special davice for this purpose see fig 1.
Note:
 * At replacement check 
the vertical position of the columns carefully check the bolted
 * Connections of 
supporting columns and the turning columns in particular for the Proper 
tightening.

Clean the surface of the insulators from dust, dirt and other 
deposits for cleaning purposes use benzene. If the contact surface shows burning 
traces clean these spots or replace the damaged parts.

Check the contact pressure and adjust it.
Note:
* Use the same thickness of the 
reference copper plate is equal to that of the contact blade the 
pulling out effort should be 10 kg force for each pair of the lamels
* If the pressure is less 
tighten the bolts and nuts of the split contact of current carrying conductors 
and parts 
* After checking the split 
contact clean the flexible coupline
Spring & blades with pure benzene and grease as figure 1 figure 2 & 
figure 3

Check all gears for the proper operation and see that there is 
no jamming or wearing of the parts and replace certain parts if necessary

Check the circuitry of the operation mechanism. Clean all parts 
and grease all friction parts of the gears and drivers
Check the grounding of the circuit breaker for the proper state

Check the value of the main blade current circuit resistance 
(micro ohm test) (it should be within 10 ohm). If the circuit resistance exceeds 
the indicated value reduce it to the rated value by adjusting the contact 
pressure and by tightening the bolted connections

Introduction
This document outlines the inspection 
checklist I1, witch must be 
performed on an annually bases or after 
heavy SC as indicated by Y1 in the above title block.

Emad 
Mabrook at El Menia substation Middle Egypt
zone, tested at 2 March 2003 
and approved at
Safety Precautions
A work permit must 
 be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable 
 safety category,
Safety fence with cautions marks surrounding the work area is required
Wear your safety helmet & shoes .... etc
Isolate DS from two sides.
Use only fiberglass ladder.
Switch off the control circuit (DC voltage)
Tools and Equipment
One set of open-end wrenches
Pure bingeing grease and wipers
Micro ohm tester
